content: World No Tobacco Day is observed annually on May 31 across the globe. This initiative was established by the member states of the World Health Organization (WHO) in 1987. Its primary purpose is to raise global awareness about the tobacco epidemic and the preventable deaths and diseases caused by tobacco use. Tobacco-related health issues are responsible for approximately 5 million deaths each year. On April 7, 1988, a call was made to designate this day as a world no-smoking day.
